_description: CL-bench acquisition-band manifest (T14). 10 selected contexts (2 smoke + 8 full) + 3 alternates, chosen 2026-06-12 from tencent/CL-bench. Selection: 1899 tasks -> 136 invented-knowledge multi-task candidates -> top 48 by rubric-determinism -> 6 parallel evaluators scored 6 axes (invented, off_fails, on_winnable, extractable, det_verifiable, sibling_quality) -> 10 picked for axis scores + band diversity + context-size spread. Every sentinel below is VERIFIED present in the context text (scripts/fetch_clband_contexts.py re-verifies on fetch; fails loud).

_dataset.license_note: Copyright 2025-2026 Tencent Hunyuan Team & Fudan NLP Group; local evaluation use. Contexts are NOT committed to this repo - fetch on demand.
_dataset.frontier_baseline: 10 frontier models average 17.2% solve WITH context provided (best GPT-5.1 23.7%); our OFF arm removes the context entirely.

contexts.name: flywheel-assembly-agent
contexts.gist: Fictional flywheel-manufacturing multi-agent system: Assembly Technician Agent B's numbered workflow, workaround protocols, mandatory spin test, communication rules
contexts._sentinel_tiers_note: T22 two-tier split. sentinels_document = system-name tier (REPORTED, not gating; the preference channel never emits these). sentinels_operative = the constants/rules Session B actually needs, derived VERBATIM from verifiers/flywheel-assembly.sh; this is the GATING tier (fidelity_gate.sh gates on it).
contexts.why: Smallest context (4.2k) with the most flat siblings (12): maximum extraction-fidelity odds for the FIRST live proof of teach->extract->inject->verify; 11 held-out siblings leave room for the OFF pre-gate to reject some

contexts.name: aether-language
contexts.gist: Fully invented 'Aether' programming language with bespoke keywords (conduit, flow, fork, swirl, Fractures) and strict response-format rules
contexts._sentinel_tiers_note: T22 two-tier split. The SMOKE teach session is the depth-2 TRANSLATE sibling (Python->Aether), so sentinels_operative are the invented keyword mappings that translate sibling needs (verifiers/aether-python-translate.sh): conduit/flow/fork/swirl + the '<<' assignment. 'Turbulence Alert' belongs to the depth-4 review sibling and is NOT taught here, so it sits in the document (reported) tier only.
contexts.why: The coding-native flagship at the LARGE end of the context range (37k): smoke spans both size extremes so extraction fidelity is proven across the band's whole envelope; multi-turn siblings exercise the turn-stub handling

contexts.name: material-handler-sops
contexts.gist: Invented semiconductor-facility Material Handler SOPs (ESD wrist strap, cart weight limit, UV cycle between cleanroom zones, IMS-before-move) tested under adversarial operator pressure
contexts.why: Highest-scoring candidate (30/30): binary fail-if rubrics, 7 siblings each applying the SAME rules under different social pressure - measures rule-retention against exactly the drift skills are supposed to prevent

contexts.name: source-integrity-agent
contexts.gist: Invented multi-agent news-verification pipeline: SIA role with rigid JSON output schema, Domain Trust Score formula, escalation thresholds
contexts.why: JSON-schema + numeric-formula rules give the most machine-checkable verifiers in the band; compositional pipeline shape maps to DS-028

contexts.name: quartermaster-hold-inventory
contexts.gist: Fictional climbing-gym Quartermaster: hold-inventory thresholds (500/Main Wall, 100/Wall 5) with HOLD_OK/HOLD_LOW/HOLD_CRITICAL_LOW status codes at 150%/100% ratios
contexts.why: Pure numeric-threshold rule application with exact status-code outputs: the cleanest mechanical-derivability case; tiny context (3.6k) + 10 flat siblings

contexts.name: dartman-game
contexts.gist: Invented 'Dartman' two-player chess-board game with custom pieces (Dartman, 1x1/1x2 Deflectors), starting positions, and win conditions distinct from chess
contexts.why: Game-state reasoning over invented rules; the model's chess priors actively mislead (the default-contradicts-convention property); deepest multi-turn chain (depth 8) stress-tests turn-stub handling

contexts.name: ezlang-language
contexts.gist: Invented minimal 'EZLang' teaching language (var/set, func with, no break, .ez files): OFF reliably hallucinates Python/JS syntax
contexts.why: Second invented language: the model's strong programming priors actively contradict EZLang's deliberate restrictions (no break, English-like keywords) - tests negative-transfer resistance (DS-029 shape)

contexts.name: drywave-3000-manual
contexts.gist: Fictional DryWave 3000 dehumidifier manual + InfoAID persona: RH target ranges per room type, operating modes, placement rules, UK-English structured output
contexts.why: Invented product spec at the largest context size in the band (49.5k): the upper-bound extraction-fidelity probe; plausible-sounding specs are maximally tempting for OFF to hallucinate confidently
sentinels_operative: Maintaining humidity below 40% for extended periods
should not be operated in Continuous mode

contexts.name: 123corp-hr-policy
contexts.gist: Fictional '123 Corp' HR policy assistant 'Jeffrey': invented accrual rates (1.54 hours/pay-period), section numbers (7.01/7.02/7.07), holiday observation logic
contexts.why: Policy-lookup shape with invented numeric constants and section references: the closest analogue to real-world 'company convention' skills, the layer's actual production use case

contexts.name: dpms-agent-m
contexts.gist: Fictional 14-agent Disaster Probability Modeling System: Agent M's report-composition rules (schema version, input-verification gate, mandatory section structure, posterior-authority rule)
contexts.why: Multi-section report-structure rules with an authority-precedence rule (Agent F posterior wins): tests structural fidelity (DS-026 shape) in a small, flat-sibling context
sentinels_document: Agent M: Report Composer & Formatter Agent - DPMS

contexts.name: shelbys-recipe-assistant
contexts.gist: Fictional Shelby's brand recipe assistant: absolute allergen bans, 15-SKU proprietary product list, prep-time cap, strict plain-text format
contexts.why: First substitute if a full-band task fails the OFF pre-gate

contexts.name: agent04-podcast-orchestrator
contexts.gist: Invented podcast-scriptwriting orchestrator: Agent 04 produces segment maps with timing that must sum exactly to episode length, never draft scripts
contexts.why: Second substitute; off_fails=3 is the weakest in the pool, so it sits behind Shelby's
